errors.text: The proposed critical onset temperature of 450–500 K conflicts with the target threshold of approximately 673 K.
The proposed heating endpoint of 800 K cannot test the target observation that the Au/Cu-rich shell melts and evaporates at 973 K.
The heating rate is reconstructed as 10 K/s rather than 1 K/s, substantially changing the kinetic history.
The cited literature does not directly support the system-specific segregation, diffusion, threshold, or evaporation claims.
